title: Practice 8: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Куда вы ___ (заезжать / заехать — to drive into, to go into; past pl.), кроме визитов?
exercises.why: **заезжали** — past tense (plural) of заезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: заехать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Но я ___ (забегать / забежать — to run ahead, to run before someone; 1st sg.) вперед.
exercises.why: **забегаю** — present tense (1st person singular) of забегать: imperfective (perfective partner: забежать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
